title: Three Roads to the Cosmological-Constant Acceleration Scale: Dynamics, Weak-Lensing Geometry, and Expansion -- and Why the Lensing Leg Is a Consistency, Not Yet a Free-Fit
description: In a de Sitter-Unruh modified-inertia framework the low-acceleration scale is tied to the cosmological constant by a0 = c^2 sqrt(Lambda/32pi) (equivalently Lambda = 32 pi a0^2 / c^4), with the coefficient Z = sqrt(32pi/3) posited, not derived. This note assembles THREE observables with ORTHOGONAL systematics that each carry an acceleration scale: (i) DYNAMICS -- the Lambda-blind SPARC rotation-curve a0-line, a0 = 1.181e-10 m/s^2 with a systematics box 0.84-1.36e-10 (stellar M/L, inclination, asymmetric drift); (ii) GEOMETRY -- the KiDS-1000 weak-lensing radial acceleration relation (Brouwer et al. 2021, A&A 650, A113), which reaches baryonic accelerations g_bar ~ 1e-15 m/s^2 (five decades below a0, where all interpolation kernels agree to ~0.14% so a0 = g_obs^2/g_bar is interpolation-free) and is consistent with the adopted g_dagger = 1.20 +/- 0.26 e-10 (McGaugh et al. 2016); (iii) EXPANSION -- the a0 demanded by the Pantheon+ supernova Hubble diagram when the Friedmann dark-energy term is pinned as Z^2 a0^2/c^2, a0 = 0.92-0.99e-10 (H0 67.4-73). The three central values span 0.96-1.20e-10 (~22-30%), all inside the SPARC box, and all invert to Lambda within a factor ~1.6 of Planck (KiDS: Lambda = 1.79e-52, Planck 0.91 sigma away in Lambda-space, 1.02 sigma in a0-space -- consistent in both frames). HONEST SCOPE, stated plainly: this is a CONSISTENCY + METHOD + FORECAST note, not a free-fit measurement. The KiDS leg is Brouwer et al.'s adopted-a0 consistency; a fresh free-fit from their published figure is reading- and scatter-limited (the photometric KiDS-bright sample is selection-biased high -- their own caveat -- and reads a0 ~ 1-3e-10 as an artifact; the reliable spectroscopic GAMA sample has ~0.2-0.4 dex per-point scatter, pinning a0 only to a factor ~2). A tabulated per-point free-fit (the data is not yet cleanly public: no VizieR entry, only raw excess-surface-density profiles) would reach ~13% statistical for the bright sample but ~43% for the clean reliable sample -- deep-MOND error propagation DOUBLES per-point scatter into a0 (a0 = g_obs^2/g_bar), a factor the first draft got wrong by 4x and which an adversarial review corrected -- so a realistic clean-sample free-fit reaches ~45%, a modest upgrade on the figure, with statistical and systematic (>= 6 sigma early/late-type RAR split at fixed stellar mass; baryonic-mass and deprojection modeling) contributions comparable. FRAMEWORK-SPECIFIC LIMIT on independence, stated openly: in modified INERTIA, lensing does not share the matter sector's effective metric -- it enters through a disformal photon sector (g~ = g + B uu), so lensing-a0 = dynamical-a0 is a PREDICTION of that completion, not automatic as in single-metric modified gravity; the KiDS agreement is therefore a bonus consistency test of the disformal sector, not an independent derivation that Lambda sets a0. The value of a0 and the constant Z remain posited throughout; the triangle tests the UNIVERSALITY and SCALE of a0 across orthogonal observables, not its precise value -- every current channel carries ~16-25% systematics that straddle both the framework's 9.36e-11 and the canonical MOND 1.2e-10, which is why the ~22% framework-vs-MOND fork remains undecided and why a single ~5-8% a0 measurement (uniform baryonic-mass calibration) is the decisive future lever. CREDIT: the RAR and g_dagger are McGaugh et al. 2016; SPARC is Lelli, McGaugh & Schombert 2016; the lensing RAR is Brouwer et al. 2021; the interpolation kernel nu(y) = sqrt(1+1/y) is Milgrom's (1999, Phys. Lett. A 253, 273). Every load-bearing number is produced by the committed, exit-0 script kids_rar_lambda.py.
notes: Referee-graded writeup (draft -> 3-reviewer adversarial panel [physics/honesty+privacy/citation] -> revise). The physics panel caught a SEVERE forecast error in the draft's own favor -- the free-fit statistical projection used sigma/(2 sqrt N) where deep-MOND propagation requires 2 sigma/sqrt N (a0 = g_obs^2/g_bar doubles log-scatter), a 4x optimism -- corrected to ~13%/~43% statistical and a realistic ~45% clean-sample free-fit, replacing the draft's '~20%' claim (the correction is recorded in-text; the two committed scripts now agree). Also added: the Lambda-space (0.91 sigma) vs a0-space (1.02 sigma) both-frame consistency note, and both-footing Lambda inversions. Privacy audit: zero personal information or email addresses (published-author citations only). Companion to the a0-line/Lambda paper (10.5281/zenodo.21419735, the dynamics leg), the cross-scale a0(z) paper (10.5281/zenodo.21440407, the expansion leg), and the MI lensing no-go (10.5281/zenodo.21418816, the disformal sector). Both a0 footings carried; a0's value and Z remain postulates; no detection claimed. https://github.com/carlzimmerman/zimmerman-formula
